verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own docs describe moving data via its tooling: the CLI walkthrough covers copying data to an instance, SSH is documented for file transfer, and a direct Jupyter connection is recommended for faster uploads and downloads. There is no evidence of S3-compatible endpoints or cloud-storage sync, and the transfer tooling appears only in brief mentions. Community reports of poor instance bandwidth add uncertainty about efficiency but do not contradict the tooling. missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, in-depth documentation of the CLI copy command, independent corroboration of transfer throughput.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling
